title: Canonical access-tail result
statement: Let $w_i$ and $w_r$ be finite bit strings, and let $e$ be a Boolean. The access-tail operation on $w_i$ and $w_r$, initialized with Boolean state $e$ and no remembered last bit, returns no value if $w_i$ is nonempty and ends in $0$; otherwise it returns the Boolean conjunction of $e$ and the statement that $w_i=w_r$.
